conceptual_change: Modify the entry logic to strictly require that the current ATR(14) value exceeds 1.5 times the 20-period SMA of the ATR(14) as a necessary condition for trade signal execution.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis (BTC_1h_016) was rejected for being unexecutable due to missing engine integration; this hypothesis formalizes the logic into a direct conditional filter to be implemented in the signal generation step to test if volatility-gating reduces false positive entries.
